paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption: The evolution of KV caches in the streaming setting.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the evolution of KV cache size over time in a streaming setting, with two panels showing different representations of the same underlying process. The top panel plots the KV cache size, denoted as π, against time, τ, with the x-axis ranging from 0 to τ₀ and the y-axis ranging from 0 to c - a. The bottom panel plots the size of the cache, denoted as S_{size_run}, against time, τ, with the x-axis ranging from 0 to τ₀ and the y-axis ranging from 0 to c. Both plots depict a piecewise linear, sawtooth-like pattern where the cache size increases linearly from 0 to a peak value (c - a in the top panel, c in the bottom panel) and then abruptly resets to a lower value (w in the top panel, w + a + s in the bottom panel) before repeating the cycle. The top panel shows the cache size fluctuating between w and c - a, while the bottom panel shows it fluctuating between w + a + s and c. The dashed lines in both plots indicate the peak and trough values of the cycle.
